messages.content: Long term I want circular polarization, but begin with a linearly polarized 2.4 GHz inset patch.

A linearly polarized 2.4 GHz inset-fed microstrip patch antenna has been established as the baseline design. The long-term goal of achieving circular polarization has been recorded for future design iterations.
Turn the current element into a row of three.

The antenna has been configured as a 1x3 linear array (a row of three inset-fed patch elements) along the x-axis with default 0.55 lambda spacing at 2.4 GHz. All geometry and port checks passed with no warnings.
Which polarization goals have I asked you to remember?

You have asked to remember a long-term goal for circular polarization (recorded as future intent: target_polarization = "circular", from your instruction: "Long term I want circular polarization"). The current physical design remains the linearly polarized 2.4 GHz inset-fed patch array.
